legend: The king of Belle Aire People's Country has come up with a new plan: he has heard about the popular phenomenon called "King of the Hill", and he would like to become one as well. To do so, he has ordered you to raise a flag on the highest hill in his square kingdom, which has dimensions n×n$$$n \times n$$$. You are given a very expensive (it is gold- and jewel-embedded) satellite-based height-measuring system. This equipment is highly accurate: the heights on every location in the kingdom are represented with distinct integers. However, to cut costs, you are only allowed to take 10n+100$$$10n+100$$$ measurements before reporting back to the king.

Furthermore, you know for certain that there is only a single point that is the absolute highest: this is the only point for which its height is larger than the (up to) four orthogonally adjacent points that lie inside the kingdom. In other words, there are no local maxima besides the global maximum.

This is an interactive problem. Your submission will be run against an interactor, which reads from the standard output of your submission and writes to the standard input of your submission. This interaction needs to follow a specific protocol:
The interactor first sends one line with an integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤10000$$$1\leq n\leq 10\,000$$$), the width and height of the kingdom.

Then, your program should make at most 10n+100$$$10n+100$$$ queries to find the highest point in the kingdom. Each query is made by printing one line of the form "? x$$$x$$$ y$$$y$$$" (1≤x,y≤n$$$1\leq x,y\leq n$$$). The interactor will respond with an integer v$$$v$$$ (1≤v≤109$$$1 \leq v \leq 10^9$$$), indicating the height at coordinate (x,y)$$$(x, y)$$$.

When you have determined the height of the highest point in the kingdom v$$$v$$$, print one line of the form "! v$$$v$$$", after which the interaction will stop. Printing the answer does not count as a query.
The interactor is not adaptive: the heights in the kingdom are fixed up front, and do not depend on your queries.
Make sure you flush the buffer after each write.
A testing tool is provided to help you develop your solution.
Using more than 10n+100$$$10n+100$$$ queries will result in a wrong answer.

legend.ai: Belle Aire People's Country 的国王想出了一个新计划：他听说了名为“山丘之王”的流行现象，也想成为这样一位王者。为此，他命令你在他的方形王国中最高的小山上竖起一面旗帜，该王国的尺寸为 n×n$$$n \times n$$$。你获得了一套非常昂贵(镶嵌着黄金和宝石)的基于卫星的高度测量系统。这套设备非常精确：王国中每个位置的高度都用互不相同的整数表示。然而，为了削减成本，在向国王汇报之前，你只允许进行 10n+100$$$10n+100$$$ 次测量。
此外，你确信只有一个点是绝对最高的：它是唯一一个高度大于王国内部（最多）四个正交相邻点高度的点。换句话说，除了全局最大值之外，不存在任何局部最大值。
这是一道交互题。你的程序会与一个交互器进行交互：交互器会从你的标准输出读取内容，并向你的标准输入写入内容。该交互需要遵循如下协议：
交互器首先发送一行，包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤10000$$$1\leq n\leq 10\,000$$$)，即王国的宽度和高度。
然后，你的程序最多可以进行 10n+100$$$10n+100$$$ 次查询，以找到王国中的最高点。每次查询需打印一行，格式为 "? x$$$x$$$ y$$$y$$$"(1≤x,y≤n$$$1\leq x,y\leq n$$$)。交互器会返回一个整数 v$$$v$$$(1≤v≤109$$$1 \leq v \leq 10^9$$$)，表示坐标 (x,y)$$$(x, y)$$$ 处的高度。
当你确定了王国最高点的高度 v$$$v$$$ 后，打印一行，格式为 "! v$$$v$$$"，之后交互将结束。打印答案不计入查询次数。
交互器不是自适应的：王国中的高度在开始前就已固定，不会根据你的查询而改变。
每次输出后请记得刷新缓冲区。
提供了一个测试工具来帮助你开发解法。
使用超过 10n+100$$$10n+100$$$ 次查询将得到错误答案。
